content: Draft a response to a customer asking why their API rate limit was exceeded. Be empathetic and include next steps for requesting a limit increase.

A customer reports slow inference response times. Write a support response asking for the right diagnostic information: model name, request volume, cluster size, and whether they've checked GPU utilization.
Summarize this support ticket and suggest next steps: Customer says their model deployment failed with 'insufficient GPU memory' error. They're trying to deploy a 70B model on a node with 40GB VRAM.
Write a polite follow-up to a customer who submitted a support ticket 5 days ago and hasn't responded to our request for logs. Keep it brief.
A customer asks: 'What's the difference between the Perses dashboards and Grafana? Why should I switch?' Draft a clear, non-promotional response.
Draft a response to a customer who wants to export their inference metrics to Datadog. Explain the OTel export path and what configuration they need.
A customer reports that their KV cache hit rate dropped from 85% to 20% after a model update. Write a troubleshooting checklist they can follow.
Write a brief knowledge base article: 'How to check GPU utilization for your AI workloads in OpenShift AI.' Three steps, no jargon.
